Next steps I propose:

2) Follow-on technical deep dive/demo with our infra engineer for architecture review - 60 min

If neither work, tell me a couple slots that do and I'll coordinate. I'll include Jonas (solutions) and Dev (lead engineer) on the respective calls so we can move quickly.
